name: Love
source:
The witch class' homeroom teacher.
Befitting of her moniker, "The Witch of Passion," her hobby is talking about all things l-o-v-e.
Love has a vivid imagination and tends to jump to conclusions whenever her old buddy Garcia is concerned.
She prefers for her students to call her "Miss Love" rather than "Professor Love."
